plan.title: Asset PR Auction Split Award to PO

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation for this case.
Enable split awarding across vendors.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Add the two vendors named in the case.
Commit the requested 30-minute schedule.
Publish the configured auction event.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Submit Vendor A's initial bid.
Verify the initial vendor bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor A's revised bid at 85.
Verify the revised bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's bid at 88.
Verify Vendor B's bid was accepted.
Wait for the auction to close before comparison and awarding.
Open the buyer comparison grid for both bids.
Verify the lowest bid ranks first, making Vendor A rank 1 at 85.
Verify the comparison grid calculates bid amounts correctly.
Enter the awarding flow for the closed auction.
Allocate six units to Vendor A.
Allocate four units to Vendor B.
Verify the split is complete and totals 6×85 + 4×88 = 862.
Approve the submitted award with the required remark.
Complete approval and create the purchase orders from the award.
Verify the split award produced PO lines for both awarded vendors.
Return to the events list to verify the event's final location.
Open the History tab for completed events.
Verify this plan's event appears in History.
